I found three CSS regressions in `site/css/styles.css` and reverted them to Bootstrap's defaults. Both the desktop and phone visual tests now pass against the existing baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

1. **Row wrapping:** `.row` had `flex-wrap: nowrap`, and I set it back to `wrap`. This was the biggest problem. On phones the columns no longer stacked, so the page stretched to 1110px wide instead of 390px.
2. **Button text colour:** `.btn-primary` had `--bs-btn-color: #000000`, and I set it back to `#fff`. The "Call to Action!" and "More Info" buttons were showing black text instead of white.
3. **Navbar toggler icon:** `.navbar-toggler-icon` was `2.25em` wide, and I set it back to `1.5em`. The hamburger icon on phones was stretched.

I didn't commit anything.
